note: LIFESTYLE EVIDENCE LEDGER - deliberately NOT a score. Lifestyle perks vary by role, grade, shift and year, and sources openly contradict each other, so any numeric index would imply precision the evidence cannot support. Each claim therefore carries its own status and sources. Keep the 100-point engineering score (gcc_ranking_scores.json) separate and unmodified: that one rests on verifiable architecture and tenure evidence, this one does not.

status_legend.VERIFIED: Stated on an official company careers/benefits page or official company blog, and applicable to the India/Bengaluru location.
status_legend.VERIFIED_GLOBAL_POLICY: Stated on an official global page, but the page does not confirm it applies to the India office. Confirm with the recruiter.
status_legend.CONTESTED_BY_ROLE: Credible sources disagree, typically because the benefit depends on grade, shift or year. Treat as a question to ask, not a fact.
status_legend.UNVERIFIED: Commonly repeated but not found on an official source during this pass. Do not rely on it.
status_legend.NOT_RESEARCHED: No lifestyle research performed for this company yet. Absence here is not a negative signal.

office_mandate.claim: Hybrid, but no specific India day-count mandate was found on an official source.

the_flex.claim: Time2Give: 10 paid volunteer days per year. Four 'Days for Me' designated days off. A paid day off for your birthday. Two gyms plus an onsite massage facility (BGL-16) on the Bangalore campus. Employee Stock Purchase Plan available in 70+ countries at a discount.

espp_discount_rate.claim: A 10% ESPP discount is widely cited, but official Cisco pages state only 'at a discount' without a percentage.

companies.standout_fun_perk: An onsite full medical centre that exists at only three Cisco sites on earth, and Bangalore is one of them.
companies.lead_assessment: The best-documented India lifestyle package in this ledger, and the claims are officially sourced rather than review-driven.

the_flex.claim: Working from Abroad up to 20 days per calendar year, conditional on legal right to work in that country and no tax or social-security consequences. Parent leave 22 weeks. companies.lead_assessment: Strongest published flexibility and family policy of any company in this ledger. The 20-day abroad policy carries real conditions, so confirm eligibility for an India contract before valuing it.

food_and_commute.claim: Not free. Lunch is roughly 50% subsidised; breakfast, dinner and late-night meals are free only on extended or overnight shifts. The official benefits page describes 'reimbursement for certain entertainment, meals, communication, and transportation' - reimbursement, not complimentary provision.

coverage.warning: Lifestyle research covers 8 of 89 ranked companies. Do not read an absent or thin lifestyle entry as a negative signal - it means no research has been done. The three companies with genuinely verified India-applicable evidence are Cisco India, Booking Holdings India and Goldman Sachs.
